source_documents.title: Photoinduced Electron Transfer Processes in 1,8-Naphthalimide-Linker-Phenothiazine Dyads

reference_evidence_units.quote: All solutions were argon-saturated unless otherwise indicated.
reference_evidence_units.subject: NI-linker-PTZ dyads
reference_evidence_units.conditions: 355 nm transient excitation selectively excites NI; time-resolved fluorescence uses 300 nm.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Experiments generally used argon-saturated solutions; PTZ does not absorb beyond 320 nm, so 355 nm excitation addresses NI.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Solution PET study, not aggregation or air-exposed solid-state emission.

reference_evidence_units.quote: This result implies that there is no substantial interaction between NI and PTZ of NI-L-PTZ.
reference_evidence_units.subject: NI-linker-PTZ ground-state spectra
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Absorption comparison in acetonitrile, toluene and n-hexane with NI reference compounds.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Similar ground-state spectra argue against substantial pre-existing donor-acceptor interaction.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Does not exclude excited-state PET or every weak conformational interaction.

reference_evidence_units.quote: two transient absorption bands were observed around 420 and 520 nm
reference_evidence_units.subject: NI-linker-PTZ dyads
reference_evidence_units.statement: Transient bands are assigned to NI radical anion and PTZ radical cation, respectively.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Radical assignment is source interpretation supported by prior spectra; exact kinetics differ among linkers.

reference_evidence_units.subject: NI-C11-PTZ
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Table 1 visually checked; acetonitrile, toluene and hexane.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Fluorescence lifetime/QY are 120 ps/0.013 in acetonitrile and 200 ps/0.008 in toluene; hexane lifetime <50 ps and QY 0.52e-3.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Triplet yield zero in acetonitrile is absence of accumulated NI triplet, not exclusion of transient triplet-mediated PET. Hexane triplet yield was not measured.

reference_evidence_units.subject: NI-C11-PTZ
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Table 2 visually checked; lifetime-difference singlet rates and transient-fit triplet/recombination rates.
reference_evidence_units.statement: In acetonitrile, source gives singlet CT 1.0e9 s-1, triplet CT 2.6e8 s-1 and intramolecular recombination 4.4e6 s-1. Toluene singlet CT is 8.0e8 and recombination 5.2e8 s-1.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Do not transfer C8 or polyether rates. Main p.4 generic 280-300 ns range does not cover the C11 Table 2 value; use target row and flag inconsistency.

reference_evidence_units.quote: the charge transfer process in toluene is the main deactivation process of NI(S1) in NI-L-PTZ.
reference_evidence_units.subject: NI-C11-PTZ within dyad series
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Toluene versus acetonitrile; fluorescence and transient timing.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Authors assign singlet-only PET in toluene but both singlet and triplet routes in acetonitrile; slow radical growth supports the latter despite no observed accumulated NI triplet.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Triplet participation in acetonitrile is a kinetic/energetic inference, not directly isolated NI(T1).

reference_evidence_units.subject: NI-C11-PTZ
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Table 3 Weller continuum treatment, PM3 extended geometry; solvent order acetonitrile/toluene/hexane.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Computed singlet/triplet PET free energies in eV are -1.31/-0.21, -0.25/+0.85, -0.05/+1.15.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Model assumes geometry and continuum solvation; folded conformers were considered but not experimentally resolved.

reference_evidence_units.quote: the kCT value of NI-C8-PTZ was larger than that of NI-C11-PTZ
reference_evidence_units.subject: NI-C11-PTZ versus C8 control
reference_evidence_units.statement: Source attributes slower C11 transfer relative to C8 to greater donor-acceptor distance.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Not a direct measurement of conformational distribution or intramolecular restriction.

reference_evidence_units.quote: These may be attributed to the very specific solvent effects such as the exciplex formation.
reference_evidence_units.subject: NI derivatives including NI-C11-PTZ in toluene
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Toluene emission redder and less vibrationally resolved than hexane/acetonitrile; NI references provide supporting comparison.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Authors tentatively assign an NI excited-state/toluene exciplex.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: No direct target-specific exciplex structure or separate lifetime component. Retain tentative interpretation, not definitive cause.

reference_mechanisms.label: ICT_TICT_CT
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Intramolecular charge-separated-state description of the same PET pathway; not TICT or a separate radiative ICT band.

reference_mechanisms.label: PET_ET
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Radical-ion transient spectra and fluorescence quenching support donor-to-NI PET; rates remain target/solvent specific.

reference_mechanisms.label: AGGREGATE_EXCITON_EXCIMER
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Preserve the explicit tentative NI/toluene exciplex assignment. It is a solvent exciplex, not an aggregate excimer or target AIE.

reference_mechanisms.label: TRIPLET_METAL_ENERGY_TRANSFER
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Triplet NI participates in PET in acetonitrile but not toluene according to the source. This does not imply RTP or triplet emission.

mechanism_decisions.label: RIM_RIR_RIV
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No target-specific restriction of intramolecular motion is established in the selected evidence; aggregation alone is insufficient.

mechanism_decisions.label: PACKING_HOST_MATRIX_CONFINEMENT
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No packing, host or matrix constraint on target photophysics is established in the selected evidence.

mechanism_decisions.label: HOST_GUEST_INTERACTION
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No target host-guest binding mechanism is established; ordinary solvent polarity is not host inclusion.

mechanism_decisions.label: ICT_TICT_CT
mechanism_decisions.rationale: Intramolecular charge-separated-state description of the same PET pathway; not TICT or a separate radiative ICT band.

mechanism_decisions.label: ESIPT_PT
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No excited-state proton-transfer photophysics is established. Ground-state protonation or hydrogen bonding alone is insufficient.

mechanism_decisions.label: PET_ET
mechanism_decisions.rationale: Radical-ion transient spectra and fluorescence quenching support donor-to-NI PET; rates remain target/solvent specific.

mechanism_decisions.label: AGGREGATE_EXCITON_EXCIMER
mechanism_decisions.rationale: Preserve the explicit tentative NI/toluene exciplex assignment. It is a solvent exciplex, not an aggregate excimer or target AIE.

mechanism_decisions.label: RADIATIVE_RATE_STATE_BALANCE
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No distinct radiative-rate or bright/dark-state balance mechanism is established beyond the other pathways; intensity and lifetime alone are insufficient.

mechanism_decisions.label: TRIPLET_METAL_ENERGY_TRANSFER
mechanism_decisions.rationale: Triplet NI participates in PET in acetonitrile but not toluene according to the source. This does not imply RTP or triplet emission.

mechanism_decisions.label: RACI_CI_ACCESS
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No target-specific conical-intersection access mechanism is established.

mechanism_decisions.label: SOKR_ANTI_KASHA
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No higher-state emission or suppression of Kasha's rule is established.
